tasks.label: Cyberpunk: Decompile Redscript bundle
args: $gitPath = (Get-Command git.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; $gitRoot = Split-Path (Split-Path $gitPath); $bash = Join-Path $gitRoot 'bin\bash.exe'; $cygpath = Join-Path $gitRoot 'usr\bin\cygpath.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $bash) -or !(Test-Path $cygpath)) { throw 'Git Bash was not found next to git.exe.' }; $script = & $cygpath -u '${workspaceFolder}\scripts\decompile.sh'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $bash $script
